d: Welcome to MultiBank Group, a global financial pioneer established in 2005 in California and now proudly headquartered in Dubai, UAE. We specialize in delivering cutting-edge trading technology, unparalleled liquidity, and exceptional customer service. Our extensive range of financial products includes Forex, Metals, Shares, Indices, Commodities, and Cryptocurrency CFDs.

Join our thriving community of over 2 million clients across 100 countries, contributing to a daily trading volume exceeding US$ 35 billion. As a heavily regulated institution with oversight from 18+ financial regulators across 5 continents, and recipient of over 80 financial awards, MultiBank Group is devoted to innovation, excellence, and empowering our clients to achieve their financial goals.

We are seeking an experienced Head of IT to lead our global IT function within MultiBank Group. This is a senior, hands-on leadership role with accountability for infrastructure, cloud, networks, corporate systems, AI applications, IT service management, business continuity and IT audits across all our offices worldwide.

You will lead the Support, Network and Systems Engineering teams and the Jira team, drive IT projects from start to finish, and build the IT foundation for every new office we open. The ideal candidate is technically strong, structured, security-minded and comfortable leading people in a fast-paced, regulated environment.
q: At least 10 years of experience in IT, including 5 years in a senior leadership role managing multiple technical teams.
Proven experience running IT across multiple countries or offices, ideally in financial services, fintech or another regulated industry.
Track record of setting up new offices from an IT standpoint.
Private or in-house cloud and server infrastructure
ITSM tools and frameworks (ITIL or equivalent) and Jira administration
SSO, identity management and user registration and provisioning flows
Good understanding of APIs and system integrations.
Practical security experience across infrastructure, endpoints, access control and data protection.
Experience designing and testing Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery plans.
Experience leading internal and external IT audits, for example ISO 27001, SOC 2 or regulator-driven reviews.
Familiarity with enterprise AI tools and the governance they require.
Experience writing and enforcing IT policies and procedures.
Experience with IT budgeting, vendor negotiation and cost control.
Strong project management skills across the full project lifecycle.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field (Master's preferred).
Certifications such as ITIL, CISSP, CISM, PMP or PRINCE2, Azure Administrator or Azure Solutions Architect, or equivalent.
Experience in brokerage, trading or exchange environments with high-availability requirements.
Experience introducing and governing AI tools across an enterprise.
Exposure to multi-jurisdiction regulatory requirements affecting IT and data.
Fluency in Arabic or another language relevant to our regions.
r: Lead, mentor and develop the Support Engineering, Network Engineering, Systems Engineering and Jira teams.
Oversee systems used by the engineering organisation and ensure Jira supports delivery teams effectively.
Define the IT roadmap and align it with business and regulatory priorities.
Own the in-house cloud servers and hosting environment, including capacity, availability and cost.
Oversee network engineering across all global offices, including connectivity, performance and monitoring.
Manage Azure and Cloudflare services, including DNS, WAF and Zero Trust.
Take responsibility for the company's SaaS portfolio, covering selection, onboarding, licensing, renewals and offboarding.
Administer Microsoft 365, including tenant security, licensing and governance.
Own SSO and user registration and provisioning processes, working closely with Security and HR.
Understand and oversee API integrations between internal and third-party systems.
Own the ITSM framework: incident, request, change and problem management, with clear SLAs and reporting.
Ensure the support desk delivers consistent service to every office and time zone.
Manage IT projects end to end, from scoping and business case through delivery and review.
Be responsible for IT in all global offices.
Lead the IT setup for new offices opened across the globe, including network, devices, access, telephony and local compliance needs.
Apply security best practice across the IT estate, working with the Security team to protect systems, data and endpoints.
Own Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery plans, including regular testing.
Be responsible for global and internal IT audits, including evidence preparation, auditor coordination and closing findings.
x: Work with an industry-leading global financial institution.
Competitive salary and comprehensive employee benefits.
Opportunities for professional growth and career advancement.
Collaborative, inclusive, and dynamic work environment.
Commitment to innovation and professional excellence.
Become part of our international community at MultiBank Group, dedicated to excellence, innovation, and shaping the future of finance.
